sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed four recommendations arising from three reports on misconduct risks in Department of Transport licensing and vehicle examinations.
sentences.support: a follow up review of Transport's continued implementation of three of the earlier recommendations.

sentences.text: The recommendations concerned driving assessment bookings, photographs of vehicle examinations, invoice audits and recognition of overseas driving licences.
sentences.support: Department of Transport implement a rigorous audit program of invoices against TRELIS.

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that booking controls and audits had improved, accepted the proposed regulatory changes and closed all recommendations.
sentences.support: Transport has considered and, where appropriate, taken steps to implement the Commission's recommendations.

sentences.text: The Commission also closed the photographic evidence recommendation after the department considered it and declined implementation because of cost.
sentences.support: Transport has considered this recommendation and determined that it is not feasible for implementation.

findings.quote: The Commission considers all recommendations closed.
The regulatory reform proposed by Transport is appropriate and logical.

notes: No separate executive summary or equivalent consolidated summary was identified. Closure of the photographic evidence recommendation does not mean it was implemented. Regulatory changes were proposed at the report date.
